name: Fake paramedic (convicted gang member; silhouette only)
depiction: One of the Dutch men convicted at Birmingham Crown Court in 2015 for smuggling drugs in fake ambulances while dressed as paramedics. Drawn ONLY as a dark rim-lit silhouette (silhouette option) in a plain green uniform-style jacket: no face, no features, no badge, no real ambulance service's uniform or markings. Never named on screen or in narration. Not a likeness. Tagged NOT A LIKENESS.
